title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. translated_title: 思考之前的思考：通过元推理扩展智能体推理
translated_abstract: 随着智能体承担越来越长、越来越复杂的问题，控制执行过程本身也成为一项任务。运行中的每一步都会带来新的控制选择，例如基于哪些部分成果继续构建、是否从头开始，以及何时停止。我们提出智能体元推理，这是一种推理时的框架，使这些选择成为一个显式且结构化的推理过程。工作器执行任务级计算，而控制器则整合运行已经确立的成果、探索下一步选项、在剩余预算下评估每个选项的价值，并结合从持久记忆中获取的上下文来分派所选的工作。在两次决策之间，控制器只携带运行的简明记录，而不是重放其完整历史。我们的基线涵盖生产级编程智能体和研究框架，以及使用相同工作器和相同计算预算配额的直接控制智能体。在用于测试长视野……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“智能体元推理”这一推理时框架，通过一个控制器对执行过程进行显式、结构化的控制决策（整合进展、探索选项、在剩余预算下评估并分派工作），从而在不重放完整历史的情况下高效扩展智能体推理。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness in which a controller makes explicit, structured control decisions—consolidating progress, exploring options, and dispatching work under the remaining budget—to scale agentic inference efficiently.
